Delete Ec Route
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:ecgroupId/vm/:vmId/route/:ecRouteId

Deletes a Cloud or Branch Connector route within a specific VM based on the provided route ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ecgroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector group ID.

vmId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM.

ecRouteId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector route ID.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

Schema
